data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for Facebook App Events and Meta ad attribution SDK.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Flutter interface for Facebook App Events, enabling measurement of app usage, ad performance, and user engagement. Mirrors the native App Events SDK surface for Android and iOS.
use_when: You need to track app events and user engagement for Facebook ad attribution.
You want to measure ad performance and build audiences for ad targeting.
avoid_when: You require analytics solutions other than Meta/Facebook App Events.
Your iOS target deployment version is below 15.0.
strengths: Supports both CocoaPods and Swift Package Manager for iOS integration.
Supports deferred SDK initialization for consent management.
weaknesses: Requires manual native configuration in AndroidManifest.xml and Info.plist.
Strict minimum requirement of iOS 15.0 and Flutter >=3.41.0.
data.setup_notes: Requires creating a Facebook app, adding app ID and client token to Android strings.xml and Manifest, and configuring Info.plist on iOS. iOS requires a minimum deployment target of 15.0.

alternatives.name: mixpanel_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose Mixpanel if you prefer a dedicated product analytics platform over Facebook's ad-attribution-focused SDK.
